Case reference: 2014002595.CaseDesc: On November 15, 1997, John Grabluk was seen for the last time at the Scarborough Postal Union Office in Toronto, Ontario. During the time of his disappearance, John had taken a leave of absence.

Case reference: 2014005327.CaseDesc: Edward Tandrup was last seen in Edmonton, Alberta in February of 1983. Edward may have been hitchhiking to Vancouver, British Columbia at the time.

Scar: Head, Deep acne scars on face

Case reference: 2014001059.CaseDesc: On July 17, 1970, the body of a heavyset young adult male with black hair was found on the shore of Kamloops Lake in British Columbia. He had all his teeth removed during his life and had no noticeable scars or tattoos. He is believed to have drowned in the Thompson River near Riverside Park a few days earlier.

Case reference: 2000000183.CaseDesc: Matthew Richard was last seen on October 30, 1999 at a truck stop in the district municipality of Sicamous in the Shuswap County region of south central British Columbia.

Case reference: 2024035505.CaseDesc: Steven Rossetti was last seen on July 9, 2024 at 8:12 p.m. in Brockville, Ontario.  The OPP conducted an extensive ground search of the area surrounding Steven Rossetti's residence beginning on July 10, 2024, and are still investigating.  Steven's friends and family have not heard from him since.

Case reference: 2014005227.CaseDesc: Carl Chenier was last seen by the superintendent of his apartment on February 23, 2009 in Montreal, Quebec. Carl may have mental health problems, but he was not on any medication. Carl often used the Montreal Metro to get around.

Case reference: 2014004681.CaseDesc: On November 22, 1965, Archie Laroque was hunting with six other people near Laroque Lake, 48 kilometers east of Carrot River, SK. The hunting party split up and Archie was last seen walking in an area alone. Extensive ground and air searches were conducted, however, Archie was never located.

Case reference: 2014001648.CaseDesc: On August 31, 1986, Gustave Focktave was seen for the last time when he left his home in the Côte-Des-Neiges-Notre-Dame-De-Grâce District of Montreal, Quebec. Gustave had left without his possessions and had left a farewell letter addressed to his family indicating that he would be hitchhiking to British Columbia to live in Vancouver. Gustave is originally from Madagascar.

Case reference: 2026007919.CaseDesc: Thomas “Joe” MacGillivary was last seen by a family member in Bible Hill, Nova Scotia on January 16, 2026.

Case reference: 2012020170.CaseDesc: An adult male was washed up along the south side of the beach at Stanley Park, near the 2000 block of Beach Avenue at English Bay in Vancouver.

Wallet: Black, Contained pliers and a jack knife
Mark: Forehead, Post mortem abrasion on the right side of the forehead

Case reference: 2010000699.CaseDesc: William Ostertag last spoke to his brother on December 16, 1990.  He was reported missing when he failed to show up for his work Christmas party in North Bay.

Hair: Black, Short, Comb over, moustache, sideburns
Coat: May have been wearing a blue or grey coat

Case reference: 2014002864.CaseDesc: Mark Garland was reported missing on November 26, 1996, to the Durham Regional Police Service.  It is believed that he went missing from Toronto, Ontario and foul play has not been ruled out.

Case reference: 2014004813.CaseDesc: Germain Gaudreault was seen for the last time on August 26, 2006, around noon in the area of the municipality of Baie-Ste-Catherine, Quebec. He was alone in his 1997 white Plymouth on Highway 138 eastbound. His unoccupied vehicle was found later that evening on the wharf of the municipality of Les Escoumins, Quebec.

Hat: Cotton, Black, "Cuba" text with Cuban flag
Tattoo: Chest, Blue dot for medical treatments

Case reference: 2014004157.CaseDesc: Mark Krostewitz was seen for the last time on June 7, 1989 in Winnipeg, Manitoba.

Case reference: 2019075539.CaseDesc: On November 25, 2019, Daniel REOCH was last seen in Squamish, British Columbia.  Daniel has not been seen or heard from since.

Blue, Black, Collared Blue black plaid long sleeve button up shirt worn over
Blue, Brown, Collared Blue brown tan plaid long sleeve shirt worn underneath
Shoes: Black, White, White trim on soles with white laces on left shoe and black laces on right shoe

Case reference: 2014004403.CaseDesc: Ramona Shular was last seen in Fort St John, British Columbia at the end of November 2003.

Mark: Mole in front of left ear
Scar: Right Eye, Scar from right eyebrow to cheek bone
Tattoo: Right Ankle, Red heart and rose

Case reference: 2006025299.CaseDesc: Eetu Vainonen has been missing from the Thunder Bay (Port Arthur) area since sometime during 1935 to 1936.

Case reference: 2014002223.CaseDesc: Edward Joseph Arcand left his residence in Coleman, Alberta on June 8, 1975, driving a 1969 Ford Falcon station wagon.  On June 15, 1975 his vehicle was found abandoned 80 km north of Coleman on highway 940.  Edward has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2008006899.CaseDesc: On November 2, 1966, Donald Wynacht and two colleagues engaged in a hunting expedition north of Sudbury, Ontario, specifically along the hydro lines, located 20 miles north of Gauthiers Corners on Highway 69, in Kitchener Township. As a snowstorm intensified, the hunters became separated along the power lines, and Donald went missing. On the morning of November 5, 1966, a police unit led the search of the area with 35 citizens and two aircrafts. The search was completed on November 15, 1966, with negative results and no evidence as to the circumstances of his disappearance.

Shirt: Wool, Red, Black, Checkered heavy doe skin

Case reference: 2020011912.CaseDesc: On May 25, 2017, Jeffrey Caporale was seen for the last time in Edmonton, Alberta. Shortly before his disappearance, Jeffrey had been treated at the University of Alberta hospital.

Case reference: 2014005292.CaseDesc: On December 4, 1992, at approximately 6:30am, Renata Ejsmont was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. The day before her disappearance, Renata had quit her job and told her former employer that she was moving back to Poland.

Case reference: 2014004619.CaseDesc: William "Billy Jay" Sharphead was last seen leaving his residence on the Enoch Cree Nation in Alberta, in September of 2003.  On that night it is believed that he got into a car.  He has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2023063442.CaseDesc: On November 18, 2023, Lindsay Woods was reported missing by his parents, as he had not returned to his home in Prince Albert, Saskatchewan, since November 15. It was reported that he was feeling despondent when he left home. Despite extensive efforts, Lindsay's whereabouts remain unknown.

Case reference: 2012020006.CaseDesc: Lucas James Degerness was last seen on June 7, 2007 in Prince George, British-Columbia. He spent that night with a friend.

Mark: Torso (Back), Brown in color, left side
Head, Dime size bald spot - front

Case reference: 2012000299.CaseDesc: Cheryl Rowe was last seen by her family on December 22, 2011, just after 12:00 a.m. on Rathfon Crescent, Richmond Hill, Ontario. Investigators believe that Cheryl may be the victim of foul play.

Tattoo: Upper Back, Children's names, two wings with the words "Shane" and "Christina"

Case reference: 2018071052.CaseDesc: On July 11, 1998, the remains of a male individual were discovered on Sulphur Mountain in Banff National Park. There is dental work present, including multiple fillings. The post-mortem interval is estimated to be between 6 months and 5 years.

Case reference: 2024050951.CaseDesc: David Mitchell was last seen on September 9, 2024 in Whites Mountain, New Brunswick, when he was dropped off at work by a family member. On September 12, 2024, the same family member went back to pick David up, he was informed that David had left the premises to go to a bar on the same day he was dropped off and failed to return. Despite extensive efforts to contact him by mobile phone, there was no response. The telecommunications provider confirmed that the last activity on David's phone was on September 9. Furthermore, the bank has confirmed that his account has been inactive since September 8. Comprehensive investigations is ongoing but these efforts have not yet yielded results.

Case reference: 2014003573.CaseDesc: On October 11, 1978, George Greyeyes left from Petersfield, Manitoba on a hunting trip. He left by canoe and was supposed to return that same day. Water conditions were poor with high winds and waves. On October 12, 1978, he had not yet returned and was reported missing to police. Searches were conducted and he was never located. George is presumed dead due to drowning.

Jacket: Nylon, Brown, Quilted plaid jacket with elbow patches

Case reference: 2014002814.CaseDesc: On December 17, 1983, Guy Turgeon was seen for the last time when he left his home in the Rosemont-La-Petite-Patrie District in Montreal, Quebec. He was despondent and suffered from mental health issues. Guy hasn’t been seen or heard from him since.

Case reference: 2012020090.CaseDesc: On April 30, 1993, a human foot and running shoe were discovered along the North Saskatchewan River, east of La Colle Falls and approximately 1 km west of the Saskatchewan River Forks Lookout, in the vicinity of Prince Albert, Saskatchewan. The foot was examined by the University of Saskatchewan Department of Archaeology. It was determined to be that of a robust male, size 10 shoe, big boned and athletic, likely between the ages of 30 and 60.

Case reference: 2014019687.CaseDesc: On November 23, 2013, an unidentified partial male skull was found in a forested area along a power line in Anmore near Coquitlam, BC. The decedent has likely been missing for several years.

Deformity: Head, Fractured facial bones. Underwent surgery to his skull, possibly during the 1980s or 1990s

Case reference: 2022057802.CaseDesc: On October 15, 2022, Kirk Allan Boucher was last seen walking without shoes in the area of the Highway 11 and 71 junction in Manitou Rapids Indian Reserve No. 11 in the Rainy River District, Ontario.

Shoes: Light Blue, Bandaged up, slip on hospital booties

Case reference: 2014032019.CaseDesc: On March 21, 1963, the dismembered remains of an unidentified man were found in burlap sacks on the side of the road near Pavilion, British Columbia. He had an old injury to his spine, likely causing pain and stooped posture, and was believed to have died a few months to years before being found.

Case reference: 2009001499.CaseDesc: Louis Riklik was last seen on October 12, 2008, in the Toronto area. On October 19, 2008, Louis entered the Bruce Peninsula National Park. His vehicle, a blue 2003 Mazda minivan, was located at the Halfway Log Dump Road parking lot. This is an access point to the Bruce trail. An extensive ground, air and water search was conducted by the OPP, Louis was not found.

Case reference: 2014004179.CaseDesc: On March 15, 1989, Leona Brule was seen for the last time in Fort Providence, Northwest Territories. During the time of her disappearance, Leona was leading a high-risk, and transient lifestyle. She may have spent sometime in Edmonton, Alberta and Florida, USA.

Teeth: Dental records indicate 7 teeth treated, 5 absent.

Case reference: 2020008533.CaseDesc: On January 15, 1982, at approximately 7:30 am, Jona Rashid was last seen on Weston Road in Toronto, Ontario. Jona had called his sister in law at 5:30pm and stated that he would be coming over for dinner.

Case reference: 2014006627.CaseDesc: On November 9, 2012, Andria Meise was reported missing from Kelowna, British Columbia. Andria was last seen in Grande Prairie, Alberta between July 2010 and September 2010. Andria was known to be living a high risk lifestyle and traveled between Grande Prairie, Dawson Creek, Fort St. John, Kelowna and Vancouver.

Case reference: 2014001425.CaseDesc: Terry Hrynick was reported missing by the manager of Sickle Lake Lodge in Manitoba in the early hours of August 3, 1986. He had spent the previous evening and early morning with friends. According to them, Terry had been very quiet in the days leading up to his disappearance. On the night of his disappearance, he was described as intoxicated. At one point, witnesses saw him stumble out the door of the cabin. About 15 minutes later, they heard a boat but did not see him. The empty boat was located the following day. An extensive search on land and water failed to find him. There was no indication that Terry found his way to shore and he has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2006020599.CaseDesc: Simon Angeconeb was last seen on July 10, 1993 at Cat Island Lodge located on Red Lake in the District of Kenora, Ontario. He was heading to his cabin to go to sleep and has not been seen since. He may have been suffering from a concussion.

Case reference: 2012002099.CaseDesc: Kelly Coleman was last seen near Mac's Convenience on Mapleview Drive in Barrie, Ontario in August 2011.  Kelly suffers from health-related issues and has not had contact with her family or friends since January 3, 2012. They are concerned for her well-being and are requesting assistance from anyone who may have had any contact with her.

Case reference: 2023005537.CaseDesc: Robey Baptiste was last seen on January 26, 2023, in Edmonton, Alberta.  Robey left his residence with a backpack containing some personal items.

Case reference: 2022005006.CaseDesc: In February 2021, Deana Timms was last seen in London, Ontario. Deana’s family and friends have not heard from her since this time. It is out of character for her to not be in contact with her loved ones for such an extended time.

Teeth: Visible Missing, Visible missing lower teeth
Scar: Left Index Finger, On the ring finger

Case reference: 2012020095.CaseDesc: On February 21, 2006, between 8:00 and 8:30 am Draper Jim was dropped off on the road by the Health Center on the Saulteaux First Nation (North of Cochin, Saskatchewan). Draper was attempting to return home to the Witchekan First Nation and has not been seen since.

Scar: Lower Lip, Left side of lower lip
Tattoo: Right Upper Arm, Ying Yang Symbol

Case reference: 2012020089.CaseDesc: Michel Guy Favreau lived alone in Nipawin, Saskatchewan at the time of his disappearance. Michel suffered from depression and he was last heard from and seen between September 22nd and September 25th, 2011. On October 4th, 2011 his vehicle, a 1998 green Chrysler Intrepid, was located abandoned at Carroll's Cove camp ground near Nipawin. Several searches were conducted in hopes of locating him were unsuccessful.

Case reference: 2020007826.CaseDesc: Gerhart Kiel was reported missing from his residence in Minburn, Alberta. His vehicle, a dark grey 2009 Ford Ranger which has a truck bed cover in the same colour, was also reported missing from his residence. Gerhart has not had any contact with his family since November 23, 2019.

Case reference: 2014002300.CaseDesc: Steven Thomas MacLaren was reported missing after failing to show up for work on July 11, 1981.  The last time he was spoken to, he said he was planning to go hiking in Kananaskis Provincial Park in Alberta. It is believed that Steven was last seen on June 29, 1981.

Case reference: 2014005157.CaseDesc: On September 22, 2008, Heinz Meyer was seen for the last time in Haines Junction, Yukon. Heinz's vehicle was later found on Marshall Creek Road in Haines Junction.

Jacket: Cloth, Dark Green, Light Green, Camouflage pattern

Case reference: 2014002313.CaseDesc: On April 5, 1986 Donald Smith was observed in the area of the Whirlpool Bridge in Niagara Falls, Ontario. At the time of his disappearance Donald was despondent and had trouble walking due to arthritis.

Teeth: False, Upper dentures and missing teeth
Amputation: Left Index Finger, Tip of left index missing

Case reference: 2020007648.CaseDesc: James Oshanek was last seen at the end of August 1991 in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014006179.CaseDesc: On July 8, 2013, Burnaby RCMP were advised that Lon Batchelor had sent his brother a letter requesting he become his power of attorney and that he give his daughter a good-bye note (stating that Lon was "going for the long walk"). This is out of character for Lon. Anyone having seen Lon since July 1, 2013, or who may be able to provide any information as to his whereabouts, is asked to contact the police.

Case reference: 2014004086.CaseDesc: On July 13,1981, Sophia Armstrong was seen for the last time. Her companion reported that she had gone on a trip, which was out of character for Ms. Armstrong.

Case reference: 2012020138.CaseDesc: The 18 month old Yohanna went missing after the mother entrusted the custody of her daughter to her boyfriend while she was out of town for a few days. They all lived in the Saint Laurent area in Montreal. Upon her return to Montreal, the mother was told that her baby was in Washington with the boyfriend’s mother. She went to the United States to find her daughter, but could not locate her. Returning to Quebec, the mother alerted the police of her child’s disappearance. The boyfriend claimed then that the child drowned in the bathtub during the mother’s absence and that she had been buried before the mother’s return. He was questioned and then released due to lack of evidence.

Case reference: 2014002978.CaseDesc: On June 6, 1982, a witness saw Louisette St-Arneault fall from the Laviolette Bridge in Trois-Rivières, Quebec. Her body was never recovered.

Case reference: 2014002991.CaseDesc: On August 23, 1988, Roberta Ferguson and eight other youths went to Sunnyside Campground at Cultus Lake in Chilliwack, BC. On August 24, 1988, Ms. Ferguson left the group on foot, it is believed she intended to return to her home in Surrey, British Columbia. Witnesses reported having seen a female walking on Columbia Valley Road, and others reported having seen a female getting into a vehicle at the intersection of Vedder Road and Cultus Lake Road. Ms. Ferguson has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2014001739.CaseDesc: In March 1994, Joseph Bucar, having been laid off from Cassiar Mines years prior, had placed his furniture and effects in storage, accumulated credit card debt and disappeared from Kelowna BC.

Case reference: 2025060570.CaseDesc: Bobbie Rae Steinhauer was last seen at the Macewan Light Rail Transit station in Downtown Edmonton, Alberta on July 9, 2025. Bobbie had no fixed address and was known to frequent Edmonton's city centre.

Deformity: Mouth, Facial tick and mouth always open
Scar: Right Forearm, Horizontal scar across inner forearm; approximately 7.5 centimetres (3 inches)

Case reference: 2014005768.CaseDesc: On March 16, 2012, Sol Han was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. That day, Sol did not show up for school.

Case reference: 2013000051.CaseDesc: Darren Fortier was last seen hitchhiking in Port Hardy on the evening of December 30, 1998.  Mr. Fortier had been involved in a serious injury a few years earlier which had left him with a metal plate and pins in his leg and a brain injury.

Hat: Cotton, Blue, Maroon, Colorado Avalanche Baseball Cap
Foreign Object: Left Thigh, Surgical Implant, Plate and 5 screws
Scar: Chin, Distinct on the left side of chin
Cheek, Down the right side of the face
Nose, Across the bridge of the nose

Case reference: 2015066565.CaseDesc: George Wood was last seen in Surrey BC, on June 20, 2015 by family. At the time George Wood was reported missing, he was unemployed and of no fixed address living on the streets in Burnaby BC. His absence and not keeping in touch with family is out of character.

Belt: Black, Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Black belt with large silver buckle
Scar: Right Arm, Long scar on right arm

Case reference: 2025039766.CaseDesc: On July 18, 2025 at 3:30 p.m. Keith Atlin asked one of his neighbours residing in the same apartment building to drive him to the Riverdale neighbourhood in Whitehorse, Yukon. Keith directed his neighbour to drop him off at the corner of Alsek Rd and Aishihik Rd, where he departed from the vehicle. Keith has not been seen or heard from since that drop off. Helicopter, drone, boat, ATV and foot searches throughout the area have been conducted but no signs of Keith have been found.

Case reference: 2006000199.CaseDesc: October 26, 1986, an unidentified man was found under the ramp to the Gardiner Expressway and Spadina Avenue behind 252 Queens Quay West, in Toronto, Ontario. He was well-nourished, and was found not wearing any clothing.

Hair: Grey, White, Short, Male pattern baldness, 4mm facial stubble
Mark: Left Elbow, Small mole on the side of his left elbow

Case reference: 2014003814.CaseDesc: On April 27, 1980, Leon Kitchekesik and his parents were staying at their cabin on Gull Lake. Leon was walking along the shore with his three year old sister. The parents went to investigate when they heard the screams of their daughter. The parents located footprints approaching a small hole and none leading away from the hole. There was a land search conducted however it is felt the boy drowned.

Case reference: 2006018999.CaseDesc: Sean MacIntyre was 13 years old at the time of a boating accident on July 25, 1980. The boat he was in started to take on water just after leaving Cockburn Island. The boat sank quickly in Lake Huron, North Channel, 2 kilometres Southwest of Bigsby Island. Occupants of the boat put on life jackets. Sean slipped out of his life jacket and is presumed  drowned. His body has never been recovered.

Case reference: 2006026699.CaseDesc: On May 22, 1967, at about 10:30 a.m. Alvin Sauder was fishing with friends in Bouillon Lake, Calvin Township, District of Nipissing, Ontario, in a twelve foot aluminum boat. He stood up and the boat capsized. Alvin could not swim and was not wearing a life jacket.

Case reference: 2006010599.CaseDesc: William Wabie was last seen as he departed in his 16 foot Starcraft boat from Bag Bay Peninsula, Shoal Lake, near Kenora, Ontario.  William never arrived at his destination of Cedar Island.

Hat: Straw, Feather on the on side

Case reference: 2014004860.CaseDesc: Lesley Holmes was reported missing by her common law husband on December 23, 2005 after not having contact with her since November 23, 2005.  They had been living in a basement apartment in Toronto, the home of a friend. Lesley did not feel comfortable staying there without her common law who was away, so she moved out. She was believed to have spent some time in a shelter but this could not be confirmed by the shelter.  Her family has not seen or heard from her since that time.

Case reference: 2014001482.CaseDesc: Ghislain Latour was last seen on December 9, 1982 at the Evain hotel in Evain village, which is now part of Rouyn-Noranda in the province of Quebec.

Case reference: 2014006533.CaseDesc: On June 18, 1983, William Fosseneuve, Raymond Sewap and another person were aboard a boat on Amisk Lake in Saskatchewan. During the course of their trip to the village of Denare Beach, the trio encountered turbulent waters, which caused William to fall overboard. In an attempt to rescue him, Raymond dove into the water. Both men were last seen submerged in the water.

Case reference: 2012020029.CaseDesc: Julie Derouin was reported missing to Lethbridge Police in June of 1983. There have been no confirmed sightings of Julie since January 1, 1980. Police investigations continue.

Case reference: 2011002999.CaseDesc: Donald Pringle was last seen on August 28, 2010. Donald takes medication and when he is not on his medication he becomes agitated and aggressive and makes poor decisions. Donald last had his medication on August 27. All family and friends have been interviewed and no one has seen or heard from Donald. He was last seen walking on Great Northern Road by Second Line East on August 28, 2010 at 2 pm.  At the time Donald was not carrying anything with him and was alone.

Case reference: 1996003690.CaseDesc: On August 29, 1994, Angela Arseneault was reported missing by her common law spouse. She was last seen on August 19, 1994, they and another male went shopping. Later that day, Angela left to catch a bus home alone. When her common law spouse returned home, the lights were on in the apartment, a window was left open and Angela’s purse was in the kitchen. Angela has not been seen since.

Tattoo: Left Ankle, rose and stem (6 inches long)

Case reference: 2014004904.CaseDesc: On the evening of April 5, 2007, Woon-Young Lee was seen for the last time at the West Park Health Centre in Toronto, Ontario.  When nurses came to Woon-Young's room the next day, she was gone.

Case reference: 2006012599.CaseDesc: Ralph Grant was last seen in the Huntsville area between January 28 and February 22, 1999. He resided on Yearly Road, Huntsville.

Amputation: Lower jaw surgically removed due to cancer

Case reference: 2014000018.CaseDesc: On March 10, 2001, Dawn Rees was seen for the last time in Calgary, Alberta. During the time of her disappearance, Dawn was leading a high-risk lifestyle.

Case reference: 2014030665.CaseDesc: On January 19, 1978, the partial remains of a female believed to be aged between 55-70 years of age, were found in the waters of the Salish Sea, southwest of Victoria, British Columbia. She had moderate arthritis and significant healed injuries to her left ankle and foot. It is believed she was deceased several months or even years before her remains were recovered

Case reference: 2021047956.CaseDesc: Gerald Smith was last seen in July 2021 in Whitemouth, Manitoba when it was believed he left alone on a fishing trip. At the time of his disappearance, Smith was discouraged following a medical diagnosis.

Fractured/Broken Bones: Right Elbow, Metal pins and plates

Case reference: 2014004877.CaseDesc: On February 9, 2006, Michelle Mercer was seen for the last time walking away from an argument with her boyfriend, in the area of 105 Street and 69 Avenue in Edmonton, Alberta.

Case reference: 2014005491.CaseDesc: On August 9, 2010, Michael Blakney was seen for the last time on a forest trail in the Scoudouc area of New Brunswick.

Deformity: Left Leg, Walks with a limp

Case reference: 2014004864.CaseDesc: On November 6, 2006, at approximately 9:00 a.m., Ahmed Moalin-Mohamed was seen for the last time as he left his apartment to search for employment in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014029389.CaseDesc: Jed Ouillette was last seen on the afternoon of September 8 2014 in the Kitchener area of Ontario. His identity documents were left at his home. Jed had lost his drivers licence due to medical conditions, including seizures, and was also experiencing financial difficulties.

Shirt: Design on the front with short sleeves and a collar.
Shorts: White, Other, Above the knees and has belt loops.

Case reference: 2006018399.CaseDesc: David Sawyer and his girlfriend were last seen on May 17, 1977. They went fishing for the day on Pickerel Lake, Ontario. Their capsized canoe was recovered but David has not been located. He is presumed drowned.

Case reference: 2006002199.CaseDesc: On September 23, 1994, this Caucasian male, was found in a field on the south side of the Rogers Centre (formerly known as the SkyDome) at the far end of Rees Street in Toronto. His post-mortem length was approximately 6’2" and he weighed 162lbs, however, these measurements may not represent his actual living weight and height due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy.

Teeth: Missing several teeth; had a great deal of restorative work done in the past with multiple silver-amalgam restorations

Case reference: 2007000199.CaseDesc: Eric Ram was last seen at 9:00 a.m., on October 5, 1991.  He left his residence to go to the local store to buy milk and a paper and never returned.

Hair: Brown, Wavy, Thick brown beard, moustache
Scar: Left Forearm, From wrist to elbow

Case reference: 2006010099.CaseDesc: David Stevens was last seen on June 14, 1979, in a canoe on the Ogoki River, approximately 70 km north of Armstrong, Ontario. He was believed to be going towards Whitewater Lake. An extensive search failed to locate him.

Case reference: 2023008747.CaseDesc: Joseph Lamartina was last seen on December 16th, 2018 when he checked out of a hotel in Niagara Falls, New York. His abandoned vehicle was located in the parking lot of the hotel on February 8th, 2019. He has not been heard from since.

Jewelry: Gold, Gold, Chain, With gold Sicilian horn
Gold, Gold, Chain, With St-Christopher medallion

Case reference: 2014003874.CaseDesc: Marthe Turcotte was last seen in Montreal, Quebec on September 13, 1971. Marthe's sister dropped her off at the Jean-Talon metro station but she was never seen again. Marthe was a student in Nursing at Thetford CEGEP in Thetford Mines, Quebec.

Case reference: 2016069642.CaseDesc: On April 21, 1995, the remains of a woman were discovered near Carbon, Alberta. The post-mortem interval is estimated to be between 10 and 15 years. The individual had dental restorations including stainless steel crowns.

Case reference: 2006022999.CaseDesc: Spike Jorgenson was last seen crossing Chief Bay, Lake Nipigon in a canoe on September 28, 1973. It is believed that his canoe capsized, and he is presumed drowned.

Amputation: Right Index Finger, at the second joint

Case reference: 2019016353.CaseDesc: On March 13 2019, Michael Steele was seen for the last time at the Cape Breton Regional Hospital Emergency Department in Sydney, Nova Scotia.

Case reference: 2014001967.CaseDesc: Mary Agnes Thomas was last seen on September 10, 1971 in a bush camp on the Fraser River approximately 2.4 kilometers from Quesnel, BC. Mrs. Thomas was with friends and is described as having been heavily intoxicated at the time of her disappearance.

Case reference: 2014005451.CaseDesc: John W. Burton and two passengers (Clifford Dowson and Edward Flett) were flying from Oxford House to Island Lake in Manitoba. John Burton was the pilot of the Cessna 185 and at approximately 11:00 a.m. he made a routine radio call stating that the plane would be landing at Garden Hill in approximately 15 minutes. The plane never arrived at its destination. The wreckage and all three souls on board were never located.

Case reference: 2012020044.CaseDesc: On December 23, 1986, Rodney Sloat was seen for the last time, by his friends, in Strathcona County, Alberta. That evening, Rodney was having dinner at his friends’ residence, and had left on his snowmobile at approximately midnight. During the time of his disappearance, Rodney may have been despondent. All of his personal belongings, identification, and snowmobile were found at his residence.

Case reference: 2023061907.CaseDesc: On September 15, 2023, Sherry Corrigal was last seen in the downtown area of Nanaimo, British Columbia. We have not had any further contact with Sherry.

Jacket: Black, Large parka or puffer jacket
Shirt: Other, T-Shirt, White or light grey colour

Case reference: 2016030649.CaseDesc: Kean Luo was originally from Malaysia, but relocated to the United States to attend school and begin his career. He relocated to Winnipeg, Manitoba on March 2, 2016, for professional reasons. Concerns were raised by friends and family when Kean was not available to receive calls or messages for an extended period of time. However, on April 2, 2016, police spoke with Kean at a local hotel in Kenora, Ontario. He stated that he was not considering ending his own life, but was experiencing stress and missing his family. His vehicle was subsequently discovered parked on the shoulder of the highway on the Sergeant Thomas Cooper Bridge (Kenora). All mobile phone and banking activity has since ceased.

Case reference: 2019040401.CaseDesc: On August 19, 1975, this approximately 60 year old man collapsed on East Hastings Street in Burnaby, British-Columbia. He had a bruise on the left side of his head and had recently undergone cranial surgery due to a head injury.

Case reference: 2025021022.CaseDesc: Patrick Chum was last seen in October 2024, in Cochrane, Ontario.  He is known to frequent North Bay, Cochrane and Moose Factory, Ontario.

Case reference: 2013000133.CaseDesc: On July 14, 2013, Prince Edward OPP (Picton) were advised of a 30 ft sailboat that had run aground on the shores at Point Petre (Lake Ontario). It was determined that the sailboat was from Rochester, New York and had left the Chimney Bluff State Park Marina (New York) on July 13,  2013 in the morning. Based on GPS tracks the investigators suspect that Scott French went overboard in American waters, and the boat drifted into Canadian Waters.

Hair: Brown, Brush Cut, Balding at the front
Shoes: Leather, White, New Balance, Running shoe
